stepTitle: Capture New Game Episode Skill Path Oracle
description: Captures the reference DOOM 1.9 new-game menu navigation path from title screen to skill confirmation: ESCAPE to open main menu, ENTER on New Game, ENTER on Episode 1 (Knee-Deep In The Dead), DOWN twice and ENTER for Hurt Me Plenty (skill 2). State snapshots at the skill confirmation tic must match the canonical reference startup parameters in src/oracles/referenceRunManifest.ts (episode 1, map 1, skill 2, deathmatch 0, single player). Entries are empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Launch DOOM.EXE via the 02-003 sandbox, wait for title stable, inject the scripted ESCAPE/ENTER/ENTER/DOWN/DOWN/ENTER sequence per the 02-010 injection oracle on consecutive tic boundaries, capture state snapshot per 02-012 at the final ENTER+1 tic boundary.

inputScript.description: ENTER select episode 1 Knee-Deep In The Dead
DOWN move to skill 2 Hurt Me Plenty (from default skill 1)
DOWN move to skill 3 Ultra-Violence then back via reset
